verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 55.19
2. Rājakārāmavagga
Dutiyadevacārikasutta
Sāvatthinidānaṁ.
Atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno—seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṁ vā bāhaṁ pasāreyya, pasāritaṁ vā bāhaṁ samiñjeyya; evameva—jetavane antarahito devesu tāvatiṁsesu pāturahosi.
verses.english: And then Venerable Mahāmoggallāna, as easily as a strong person would extend or contract their arm, vanished from Jeta’s Grove and reappeared among the gods of the thirty-three.

verses.pali: Atha kho sambahulā tāvatiṁsakāyikā devatāyo yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṁ mahāmoggallānaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhaṁsu. Ekamantaṁ ṭhitā kho tā devatāyo āyasmā mahāmoggallāno etadavoca:
verses.english: Then several deities of the company of the thirty-three went up to Venerable Mahāmoggallāna, bowed, and stood to one side. Moggallāna said to them:

verses.pali: “Sādhu kho, āvuso, buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṁ hoti—
verses.english: “Reverends, it’s good to have experiential confidence in the Buddha. …

verses.pali: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṁ buddho bhagavāti.
Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho, āvuso, evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapannā.
verses.english: It’s the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, have been reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Sādhu kho, āvuso, dhamme …pe…
verses.english: It’s good to have experiential confidence in the teaching. …

verses.pali: saṅghe …pe…
ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanaṁ hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṁvattanikehi.
verses.english: and to have the ethical conduct that’s loved by the noble ones … leading to immersion.

verses.pali: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanahetu kho, āvuso, evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapannā”ti.
verses.english: It’s the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, have been reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.”

verses.pali: “Sādhu kho, mārisa moggallāna, buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṁ hoti—
verses.english: “My good Moggallāna, it’s good to have experiential confidence in the Buddha …

verses.pali: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṁ buddho bhagavāti.
Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho, mārisa moggallāna, evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapannā.
verses.english: It’s the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, have been reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Sādhu kho, mārisa moggallāna, dhamme …pe…
verses.english: It’s good to have experiential confidence in the teaching. …

verses.pali: saṅghe …pe…
ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanaṁ hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṁvattanikehi.
verses.english: and to have the ethical conduct that’s loved by the noble ones … leading to immersion.

verses.pali: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanahetu kho, mārisa moggallāna, evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapannā”ti.
verses.english: It’s the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, have been reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
